Yoshitsugu Matsuoka (Japanese: 松岡禎丞 Matsuoka Yoshitsugu) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Matsuoka was born on September 17, 1986 in , , and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the during , replacing Tatsuhisa Suzuki as Galar Gym Leader Raihan.
